findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, list_new_tools, list_referrals, submit_tool · Private data: search_tools · Public sink: list_referrals, submit_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, list_new_tools, list_referrals, submit_tool · Private data: search_tools · Public sink: list_referrals, submit_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
